items.item_text: Certified Medical Assistant (CMA) OR Certificate of completion of a Medical Assistant training program.
BART or BLS/CPR at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations in San Diego based on business needs.
Must be able to work at three different clinics in La Jolla and work overtime as required.
May be required to secure transportation and pay parking fee at multiple locations within the same day.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Position requires minimum 1 weekend/month (Saturday and Sunday) and 3-4 holiday shifts/per year as a on call basis.
Two (2) or more years of Medical Assistant experience.
One years of experience working in Infertility.
One (1) year of experience minimum as an MA in an acute care facility or Ob/Gyn.
One (1) year procedure, reception, authorizations, and referrals experience.

Under direct supervision of the Reproductive Endocrinology and Fertility Clinic manager and the general supervision of the clinic providers and licensed nursing staff, performs work which requires specific knowledge and training in patient care duties within business and professions code of the State of California and/or the regulations The Joint Commission (TJC).

Duties also include but are not limited to: scheduling of patient appointments and associated patient system screens; environmental care functions; equipment/supply management; and cleaning/disinfecting the environment. Requires knowledge of medical terminology, on-line scheduling (Epic), universal precautions, and proper use of body mechanics. Position requires initiative, the ability to prioritize demands and the ability to work in a team environment. Will provide non-licensed medical support to medical care providers in an outpatient setting.

Incumbents room patients; set up equipment and instruments, maintaining sterile technique as required; independently perform and/or assist providers with performing exams and procedures, including administering injections: collect, prepare and analyze specimens, provide instructions, training, test results and advice to patients; review and route medication refill requests; sterilize instruments; clean and calibrate equipment; clean and stock exam rooms; and provide proper documentation in patient chart. Incumbents will assist with ultrasound set up and high-level decontamination of supplies and endocavity probes. Will be required to keep up on preventative maintenance and daily quality checks. Will also provide front office services including checking in patients, confirming authorization and insurance, discussing financial questions, and scheduling appointment on a routine or back-up basis.
Currently pursuing LVN, RN, PA, or MD education.
Knowledge and training in patient care, environmental care functions, equipment/supply management and cleaning / disinfecting the environment.
Knowledge of online scheduling, universal precautions, and body mechanics.
Demonstrated ability to take initiative, prioritize demands and work in a team environment.
